verdict.rationale: Acting as an MCP client is a fair question for an AI-era note-taking app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Obsidian can connect to MCP servers or use their tools. The general plugin API and third-party LLM plugins (Text-Generator, Copilot) are developer building blocks or community add-ons, not a documented first-party MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
